supersedes: 0.1 only after change-control adoption in an authorized loop
expanded_objective: Create a richer, more authentic, photo-led informational website explaining La Bulle Bleue and its parent association APAiL, reflecting recent activities while helping visitors contact or support the association.
new_content_requirements: Clearly distinguish La Bulle Bleue (local welcome initiative) from APAiL (parent association).
Add sourced history and wider solidarity mission of APAiL, including international work where adequately supported.
Show specific activity examples from current public posts, clearly framed as recent examples rather than promised recurring sessions.
Add a photo-led activity/gallery experience with captions and dates where verified.
Keep disputed activity venue and unverified schedule unpublished.
Do not publish participant names, diagnoses or medical outcomes.

design_direction.style: Warm, authentic, editorial, friendly, inclusive and human; not clinical or infantilizing.
design_direction.visual_assets: Approved association photography plus original illustrative assets where genuine photos are unavailable.
design_direction.visual_identity: Use the official blue bubble identity if the association supplies/clears it; current public photo is only a reference.

motion.implementation: CSS and small amounts of vanilla JavaScript

image_policy.direct_page_photos: Do not reuse without association/photo rights-holder permission and releases as applicable.
image_policy.participants_and_minors: No identifiable participant image without appropriate explicit consent; no participant names scraped from posts.
image_policy.ai_generated_assets: Allowed as clearly illustrative, not as documentary proof of actual activities.

acceptance_scope: Candidate website implementation and tests; production certification and deployment remain separate.
outstanding_unknowns: Direct Facebook page verification is throttled; aggregator mirror is medium-confidence evidence.
Image rights and participant/guardian consents are unknown.
Official logo source file and visual standards are unknown.
Current activity venue and current schedule remain unconfirmed.
approval_state: Adopted as active evidence-derived baseline in Loop 003; not human-approved and does not authorize deployment.
